description: Form 278 annual financial disclosures of members of Congress and congressional candidates, one row per filing. The same filings are published free as news at https://keyvex.com/disclosures under 5 U.S.C. § 13107(c). Parsed rows carry assets[] and liabilities[] as disclosed RANGES; a House row KeyVex may have misread carries parse_unreliable: true. Fields: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_annual_financial_disclosures

party.description: Exact match on the record's party, where the party is the party the member held on the date of the record (a trade's transaction date, a disclosure's filing date); for a date outside the member's terms in office, the party of their nearest term (the last one before that date, or the first one after it). Here: filing_date.

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on the sort field; refused with sort_by=filing_year.

name: get_annual_financial_disclosures
